Projects

Every project begins with a different challenge.

Some organizations need to strengthen collaboration. Others want learning experiences that people actually remember. Others are trying to develop leaders or navigate organizational change.

These case studies show how I've partnered with universities, scientific organizations, nonprofits, and community groups to design participatory experiences rooted in research, creativity, and community.

Rather than offering one-size-fits-all workshops, I work collaboratively to design experiences that fit each organization's goals, people, and context.
